title: Implement JSON-only gateway finalization
description: Adds generated complete-task, strict result v2 validation, restart-safe recovery, corrective reprompt, and synthetic failure.

requirements.summary: Use one strict agent-authored JSON result.
acceptance: AGENT_RESPONSE.md is not generated or required.
Agent result schema version 2 is strict and gate-order aware.

requirements.summary: Finalize every terminal status through one gateway command.
acceptance: Runtime handoff contains an authoritative result path and generated complete-task command.
Completion marker is atomically bound to the result SHA-256.
agent_running tasks resume after daemon restart.
One corrective reprompt is issued when the session becomes promptable without finalization.
A bounded synthetic failure completes the task after the grace period or timeout.

requirements.summary: Validate successful repository state before publication.
acceptance: Implementation/evidence ancestry, exact branch head, remote head, clean worktree, scope, and committed evidence are verified before completion.

gpt_static_checks_performed: Inspected gateway 0.3 runner, handoff, task model, Airelay status API, app queue logic, bus publication, CLI, and planner 1.3.0 protocol.
Authored complete production replacements and regression tests.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: Repository-wide go vet/test/build against the full source checkout.
Installed daemon replacement and runtime smoke.
known_integration_risks: The patch depends on planner main being exactly f8cb8bc67c138f7e0e026c9270d3bd89dcd855d1.
The local agent may make only compile-driven narrow repairs inside declared scope.
forbidden_deviations: Do not redesign bus branches or migration.
Do not merge, release, install, restart, or mutate runtime during implementation.
Do not restore AGENT_RESPONSE.md as a required output.
Do not broaden beyond declared files without stopping for GPT review.
